orientation_labels.label: Bisexual
orientation_labels.definition: Attraction to more than one gender

rules: Orientation is not inferred from appearance, a scene, partner configuration or browsing history.
A bisexual orientation label does not imply that every scene contains multiple genders.
Orientation metadata is optional and should be self-declared or supplied by an authorised rights-holder.
Do not create a user's personal orientation profile from viewing or search activity.
